sections.title: Order
sections.narrative:
Clinical indication: heart failure? pleural effusion? pneumonia?
Accession number: RTG-20260612-0042

sections.title: History
sections.narrative: Known chronic heart failure and emphysema. Increasing dyspnoea and leg oedema over the last week.

sections.title: Comparison
sections.narrative: Compared with the study of 2025-11-03: pleural effusion is new, otherwise unchanged.

sections.title: Findings
sections.narrative: Enlarged heart shadow. Mildly dilated vessels in the upper lung fields. Small bilateral pleural effusions. Hyperinflated lungs.

sections.title: Impression
sections.narrative: Cardiomegaly and small bilateral pleural effusions, consistent with heart failure. Emphysema. No pneumonia.

sections.title: Recommendation
sections.narrative: Repeat chest X-ray if symptoms persist after treatment.
